meaning: One of the most common verbs; used for making or doing things.
Expresses possession; also used in many idiomatic expressions.
Expresses ability or possibility.
Used for speaking or communicating information.
Movement from one place to another.
To perceive with the eyes; to watch.
To transfer something to someone.
Knowledge of facts or how to do something.
To be familiar with people, places, or things.
Expresses desire or affection.
To reach a destination.
Has multiple meanings depending on context.
To discover or encounter someone/something.
To experience emotions or physical sensations.
To try to find something.
To have faith in or consider something true.
To communicate verbally.
To transport or wear something; also time elapsed.
To abandon, allow, or stop doing something.
To go after or to keep doing something.
